{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_count = df[duplicate_patients]['patient_id'].value_counts().sum()

# Count how many patients have multiple rows
dup_ids = df[duplicate_patients]['patient_id'].unique()
num_retested = len(dup_ids)

print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {dup_count}')
print(f'Number of patients re-tested (appear >1 time): {num_retested}')

# Check sample_seq for each patient to see if higher seq supersedes
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

print(f'After deduplication, dataset has {len(df_dedup)} rows (was {len(df)})')"}
